hypothesis_statement: AGENT HYPOTHESIS (pre-experiment): For pool calibration_run_3, applying the calibrated CHGNet energy-above-hull stability gate will remove some candidates but leave most of those that would pass the Materials Project stability criterion, because CHGNet hulls are trained on MP-like data and the gate threshold was calibrated to align with MP-stable labels.

retrospective_mp_metrics.label: retrospective_calibration_metrics (in-sample, MP GGA/GGA+U hull <= 0.05 eV/atom)
retrospective_mp_metrics.warning: In-sample: the screening cutoff was calibrated on this same pool, so retrospective recall/precision here are a consistency check, not evidence of generalization.

required_next_validation: Held-out evaluation of the calibrated cutoff on compounds not used for calibration (requires a CHGNet compute tool; not available in this loop).
spec_expected_learning: If most MP-stable candidates in calibration_run_3 still pass the deployed screening cutoff after relaxation and hull, the hypothesis is supported for this pool and we can treat the gate as a low-cost pre-filter before proxy or downstream tests. If recall against MP-stable labels is materially lower than precision suggests, or many MP-stable structures are rejected, the next decision should tighten validation (held-out recalibration, lower cutoff, or not gating this pool on hull alone) before scaling the screen.
spec_stop_rule: Stop after one batch on pool calibration_run_3 with controls passing; do not repeat chgnet_triage on the same pool unless controls fail or the batch is invalid. If deployed-policy in-sample recall at cutoff is insufficient to leave most MP-stable-labeled candidates, halt gate-dependent funneling and escalate to Analyst/Auditor before another stability-gated batch.
caveat: CHGNet triage only, not DFT validation. DEPRIORITIZE does not mean unstable. Cutoff was calibrated in-sample on 39 compounds; precision/recall unverified on held-out data.
